parsed.summary: Wacky Wheels San Antonio is down 2027-03-19 to 2027-03-22, resulting in 6 production orders moved, 27 dealers notified once each for 55 customer orders, and 6 loaners assigned. Quanta Silicon's infotainment chip shipment SH-0190 to Wacky Wheels Princeton slips from 2027-03-15 to 2027-03-19. This caused 8 affected production orders to be moved to the earliest free slots, 29 dealers to be each notified once for 67 customer orders, and 20 Platinum or Gold customers to receive loaners within pool limits.
parsed.decision_reason: The system acted on every confirmed incident because IDs and dates were resolved against the data, the rehearsal on the digital twin passed with zero failures, and the live baseline matched before the first write. These actions were driven by the rules for plant outage and supplier delay incidents.
